name: PEEK
author: swtdr34mz
summary: A Peak-style 8- or 16-voice hybrid poly: three oscillators with shape, VSync, saw density and 60 wavetables, linear FM, ring mod and noise, a 12/24 dB LP/BP/HP filter between two drives, three looping envelopes, four LFOs, a 16-slot mod matrix and 4-slot FX matrix, arp, distortion, chorus, delay and reverb. ECO and HIGH quality.
